# Source attribution

Unchanged source material from https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable, pinned at 9fadc41729c38fd47d7ae622b501558653f9d2e9, retrieved 2026-11-03. The original Apache 2.0 license is retained. Exact paths, URLs and checksums are recorded in upstream-manifest.json.

The EJ application uses a modified, reviewed adaptation in ../../ej-social-design/SKILL.md. The original files here are provenance data, not dynamically loaded instructions. The adaptation preserves the client's fonts, colors, original logo, editable HTML/PNG output and configured Sol model. It adapts typography, spatial hierarchy, color roles and render verification to social graphics rather than importing a different visual identity or the original host's CLI workflow.

No external scripts, fonts, browser packages or executables are installed or run by this integration.
